name: STIHL MSA 160 C-B
blurb: Battery saw. 10″, 12″ and 14″ bars on 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 56, 64 and 72 drive links (71 PM3).
intro: The STIHL MSA 160 C-B is a battery saw. STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists 1/4″ PICCO at .043″ gauge: 71 PM3 56 on 10″ (bar 3005 008 3403), 71 PM3 64 on 12″ (bar 3005 008 3405) and 71 PM3 72 on 14″ (bar 3005 008 3409). The specification table (catalog p. 64) lists 10–14″ and 1/4″ P PM3. STIHL's file table lists 1/8″ (3.2 mm) for 1/4″ PICCO.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists chain 71 PM3 56 with recommended bar 3005 008 3403. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 10″ bar, sprocket nose R with 8 teeth. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists chain 71 PM3 64 with recommended bar 3005 008 3405. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 12″ bar, sprocket nose R with 8 teeth. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists chain 71 PM3 72 with recommended bar 3005 008 3409. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 14″ bar, sprocket nose R with 8 teeth. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, battery guide-bar chart (catalog p. 167) and specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024), read 7 Nov 2026. File size from the catalog file table: 1/8″ for 1/4″ PICCO.
